info.name: RAG API — Ingest Delete & Wipe
info.description:
Test delete and wipe ingestion endpoints.

SETUP: Set base_url variable (default: http://localhost:8000)

⚠️ WARNING: DELETE /ingest/wipe and POST /ingest/reindex will permanently delete all Qdrant vectors.

SAFE flow:    1 → 2
DESTRUCTIVE:  1 → 3 or 4

request.description: Check Qdrant collections and tracker state. Always run this first to see what data exists before any delete/wipe.

Delete vectors for a single file from Qdrant and remove it from the tracker.

collection: 'pdf' or 'audio'
filename: exact filename as stored (e.g. 'biotech.pdf' or 'lecture.mp3.json')

This is safe — only affects the one file specified.

⚠️ DESTRUCTIVE — Deletes ALL vectors from both pdf_collection and audio_collection and resets both tracker state files.

Does NOT re-ingest. After this, run POST /ingest/all or POST /ingest/reindex to re-populate.

⚠️ DESTRUCTIVE + SLOW — Wipes all vectors and immediately re-ingests all PDF and audio files from scratch.

This may take several minutes depending on number of files.
After completion, run DELETE /cache/flush to clear stale cached answers.
